about: Road tunnels dug through Underdark cave rock. cost: one metre dug, relative to one metre of open ground, for the cultures that dig (a culture not listed never digs). maxLength: longest dug stretch (m). maxGrade: steepest grade between its two mouths. perMap: dug tunnels on a 10 km map at amount 1 (scaled by the square root of the map width).
